actions.script: rule=pricingRuleId ? ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.pricing.PricingRule').condition('pricingRuleId',pricingRuleId).disableAuthz().one() : null def org=ec.service.sync().name('zenith.pricing.RuleServices.get#RuleOrganization').call().organizationPartyId allowed=rule!=null && (ec.user.isInGroup('ADMIN') || (org && rule.organizationPartyId==org)) if(!allowed && errorOnDenied!='N') ec.message.addError('Pricing rule not found or outside your active organization.')

return.message: You have view-only access to pricing rules.
Select your authorized active organization before creating a pricing rule.
